Give a thunderous round of applause for the [b]Voltaic Wraith[/b], one of the deadliest and most menacing creatures ever seen in Dark Hours. Watch out, or you might become a danger to your allies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/84739feaa21a231338870077e9a25cbaf25a6db6.gif[/img]

One of our sources says this power plant is a great place for a heist! It should be empty... seems like the perfect plan! What could possibly go wrong?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/04f12ce85a05ba4bb993a1d1e378e4bbb5799e42.png[/img]

Watch your step on the stairs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/cbffeaaba06242600978baa0f080a33e738e224f.png[/img]

The boss says it’s time to level up your criminal skills! Your new job? Plant explosives. As long as the money’s good, who’s complaining?

Magic mirror on the wall, who is the fairest one of all? Alright, it’s not magical — but it’s definitely powerful!

Check out this brand-new gameplay item to protect yourself or move around — whether you're alone or with a partner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/d680d98f519784770d25c48a6f1e440dff967ddd.png[/img]

There’s only one way to reach the Core — and this new minigame controls it. But once it's started, there's no turning back. 

Don’t forget — we’re burglars here, and we don’t shy away from danger! 



[h3]🎭Nuclear Power Plant Customization[/h3]
Stay undercover with the right gear: toolbag in hand, goggles on your face, and eyes on the objective. 

This update introduces 4 new customization items: 
[list]
[*] A stylish team bag
[*] 2 sets of protective goggles
[*] A gas mask
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/4c85789d8ad763634161a5daf7b2cedc3e53340c.png[/img]

As with every update, we’ve taken the opportunity to fix bugs you’ve reported. Scroll down for the full patch notes!

[previewyoutube=FgGEVRfggD0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What does Dark Hours FULL GAME have that the Prologue doesn’t?[/h2]

The Prologue is a free, limited experience that gives you a taste of what Dark Hours is all about. The full game offers much more content, including:
[list]
[*] 7 terrifying monsters
[*] 4 environments, each with 16 procedurally generated layouts
[*] Tons of customization options, from glasses to team bags
[*] Plenty of new items to help you survive — or betray your friends 🙄
[*] And so much more!
[/list]

notes.title: Patchnote #10 for Dark Hours Prologue (0.6P.14556)
notes.content:
[h2]Patchnote #10 for Dark Hours Prologue (0.6P.14556) - 04/12/2024[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Backpack Collision Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where players could collide with the invisible Hidebehind.
[*][b]Teambag Amount Fix:[/b] Stealing an item from a dead player's backpack no longer subtracts from the teambag amount (also prevents negative values for the teambag score).
[/list]
[h3]Monsters[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Monster Navigation Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where Statues and some other monsters couldn't move properly.
[*][b]Monster Behavior Fixes:[/b] Improved handling of attacks in monster behaviors and their subsequent actions.
[*][b]Monster Door Crossing Fix:[/b] Fixed door-crossing issues that blocked monsters; monsters can now catch players while crossing doors.
[*][b]Banshee Exploration & Standby Fix:[/b] The Banshee performs a few movements during exploration before teleporting away. If spotted during the 3rd movement, it now properly cancels exploration to scream instead of continuing and then teleporting away.
[*][b]Banshee Cancel Tweaking:[/b] Improved the cancelation of the Banshee's scream action (still requires VFX feedback if the scream is canceled at the moment it is triggered).
[*][b]Blind Ghoul In Control Room Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where the Blind Ghoul could get stuck in the control room.
[*][b]Blind Ghoul Invisible Grid Fix:[/b] The Blind Ghoul no longer lifts invisible grids in single-player mode.
[*][b]Blind Ghoul Hearing Tweaks:[/b] Increased detection sensitivity for players' voices and some other SFX.
[*][b]Blind Ghoul Locker Door Fix:[/b] The Blind Ghoul no longer opens locker doors when opening a nearby room door (rare cases).
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Camera Speed Settings Fix:[/b]The camera speed (mouse sensitivity) setting in the Control Settings now applies and saves properly.
[*][b]Network Optimization:[/b] Removed unnecessary stamina regeneration network synchronization when empty.
[/list]

[h3]Known Bug:[/h3]
If you're hit by a tranquilizer dart and fall asleep while exiting the building, there is a chance you may desynchronize from the victory screen and be kicked from the lobby or experience a crash.

[h3]Specific Full Game Fixes:[/h3]
[h3]Monsters[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Hidebehind Behavior Cleansing:[/b] Fixed behavior glitches caused by uncleansed states after a teleport.
[/list]

notes.title: When is the Early Access release of Dark Hours?

Hey everyone,

First off, I want to thank you all for the amazing support and excitement you show for Dark Hours. We’re so happy to have such a passionate community by our side.

Now, let’s talk about what you’ve all been waiting for : 
[h3][b]When is the Early Access release?[/b][/h3]


We know we’ve been quiet lately, and many of you have been asking about the Early Access release date. Today, I’d like to share some insights on the development of Dark Hours over the past few months. 

When we began working on Dark Hours, all we wanted was to create a fun co-op horror game to enjoy with friends, and we didn’t expect such an amazing reaction from you all. The enthusiasm you’ve shown for the game has been incredible — more than 2 millions downloads for the demo and the prologue as I’m writing these lines… mind-blowing! — and your excitement to see more is beyond what we ever dreamed of.

With so many players on board, we definitely feel the pressure now. As the saying goes, with great power comes great responsibility, and we’re aware of the high expectations for the Early Access release. Gosh, this is challenging, but we’re dedicated to meeting those expectations and offering you a truly unique and fun co-op heist-horror experience that lives up to your excitement.


That’s why we’ve taken the time to read all your messages, comments and feedback, and to respond as much as we can on the Steam forums and our Discord (and yes, it takes time!). We’re also actively working on many new features that we want to have ready for Early Access, including:
[list]
[*] New scary monsters
[*] Difficulty levels from Easy to Nightmare
[*] Customization options like colors and items
[*] Procedurally generated maps - which is not so easy to implement 😅
[*] An improved gameplay loop to immerse you even more into your heist night
[*] New missions other than stealing the Royal Crown
[*] New gameplay items, and fun gameplay features
[*] … and other cool stuff I might have missed
[/list] All this to ensure we can bring you the best possible experience for you and your friends.


[h3]So, we’ve decided to reschedule the Early Access launch to the end of October.[/h3]

This extra time will allow us to add and polish all these exciting new features you’ve been asking for.

notes.title: Future improvements for joining friends and some tips!
notes.content:
Hello!
You might read because you want to be prepared for your future games or because you're having hard time to be able to play with your friends! Don't worry we'll help!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069451/4a59def61cfa46b4c1881976039284c4dfeff33b.png[/img]

The game is a great success, that's cool! There is a lot of players... the downside that means, there is a lot of people creating lobbies and games that might affect the connections of some of you, and we're sorry about that! Because it's happening while there is a lot a people playing at the same time, we have investigated a little bit and we might have found a bug that prevent the created lobby to be reach when there are more than 50 lobbies created at the same time (that doesn't count of current games already in play)... 
We still need to confirm that but that might be your issue if you're trying to join a private lobby of your friends and having difficulties to do so. Check below for the solution using the Steam Friend invite feature to solve that.
At the beginning of the next week we'll finish to track this case, and bring a more robust solution for the list of lobbies.

But first, some facts:
[list]
[*] There is no restriction to play with someone of another country / region, so you can play with your foreign friends!
[*] We are using a peer-to-peer connection for players to host the game through the Steam network API, meaning it's robust they have a lot of technology that make online games possible for thousand of people!
[/list]

Secondly, let's check some basics,  just to be sure that this is not another issue:
Check you are playing the same version of the game because currenty it exists:
[list]
[*] the freshly released version "Dark Hours Prologue" 
[*] Dark Hours "demo" which is not up-to-date
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2208570/Dark_Hours/
[/list]
Even if you are all using Dark Hours Prologue, check your version number ingame because you also might have a different version if one of you got a patch and not the other one(s)

Now that you have check the basics:

[h3]How to create a game?[/h3]
[list]
[*] In the game, chose "Create a lobby"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069451/1aca42a4573fd10f0fe84730e53c2ab553d2f68e.png[/img]
[*] When the lobby is created, it is public by default, other people should see your lobby in the lobby list using "Join a lobby" in the main menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069451/e7f42f7af898856abe1cd52eaf98e1a119571890.png[/img]
[*] To play only with your friends without any unwanted guest, you can also choose to make it private by clicking the "private" checkbox on top-left of the newly created lobby. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069451/d44705627e22c6455a42a2e694297b37528efe11.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]My game is private, how can my friends join me?[/h3]
When you have made the lobby private, your friends can join you either because:
[list]
[*] you have shared the invite code: there is button to copy it directly. You can send the code through pm, text message or orally (if you remove the hidden option, you can read it)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069451/7ddb397c11571a0bfd5e7397c27eeba8af48f51c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069451/b93b4cbd8759d2c0bafb71a7d78e09f09a58c51a.png[/img]
[*] you have used the Steam Friends list interface to invite your friend. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069451/5a7191ba3b741558d540a1262a357374c868f6ac.png[/img]
[b]Warning:[/b] this option is working fine but only if your friends haven't launch the game before you invite them. If they are already in game, nothing will happen. If they are in the game and they accept, their game will be launched and they will join you automatically.
[/list]
In our humble opinion, the most comfortable way, is to invite your friends in game directly through your Steam friends list... if they havent launch the game.

[h3]How can I invite a friend through the Steam Friend list ?[/h3]
When you have created a lobby in Dark Hours, switch back to the Steam Friends interface (alt-tab or using the Steam overlay) 
Then right click on your friends names in the Steam Friend List and click "invite to play"
Here's a video showing the steps: 
[previewyoutube=Y88VTF9l3O8;full]https://youtu.be/Y88VTF9l3O8[/previewyoutube]



I hope this explanation have helped you. If you are still getting issues to connect to your friends, feel free to use the Steam forums and discussions or to join our discord server: https://discord.gg/pieceofcake and we'll try to help you through

Find this article here on our Steam forums: https://steamcommunity.com/app/3064370/discussions/0/4523386686506462809/


We are again very sorry if you had hard time playing with your friends, we didn't expect so many players. 
At this moment of writing, this is the weekend, so our dev team is getting some well deserved rest, but we will continue to improve the game and fix glitches and issues early next week!

Thanks a lot for your support, your kind feedbacks and to have fun on Dark Hours Prologue!

Cheers, 
Raven
